plan.title: SSB Interview & Core Weakness Mastery Plan
plan.summary: A 2-week intensive plan balancing SSB interview preparation with your mock test weak spots like Puzzles and Blood Relations. Daily commitment is 2 hours.

weeks.focus: Conquering weak topics (Puzzles & Blood Relations) & SSB Basics
weeks.milestone: Complete weak-topic drills and build SSB PIQ foundation.

tasks.activity: Solve 15 seating arrangement puzzles and note down mistakes.
Practice 20 complex coded relation problems.
Read 2 editorial articles and solve 10 RCs.
Practice 10 TAT and WAT practice sets from guidelines.
Advanced floor & box puzzle practice with timer.
Draft and refine Personal Information Questionnaire (PIQ) answers.
Timed quiz on family tree and pointer-based questions.
Revise grammar rules and practice 25 vocabulary questions.
Revise group obstacle techniques and lecturette topics.
Mixed logical reasoning sectional test.
Take a timed full-length practice test.
Review all mistakes thoroughly and note concepts.
Light revision of puzzle tricks; rest for the afternoon.

weeks.focus: Full Mocks, Revision, and Advanced SSB Practice
weeks.milestone: Master time management through mocks and polish SSB interview responses.

tasks.activity: Rapid-fire puzzle solving to increase speed.
Situation Reaction Test (SRT) - practice 30 situations.
Reading comprehension timed test.
Mock self-introduction practice in front of a mirror.
Target Exam Day: Light revision of weak areas.
Practice speaking aloud on 5 current affairs topics.
Take a full-length mock test under exam conditions.
Analyze accuracy gaps in reasoning and English.
Targeted practice on remaining weak question types.
TAT story writing practice focusing on positive outcomes.
Revise all formula sheets, notes, and golden rules.
Mental preparation and physical rest.
Light review of interview pointers and relaxation.

tips: Maintain consistency by strictly adhering to the daily 2-hour limit.
Focus deeply on your weakest areas like Puzzles and Blood Relations.
Practice speaking aloud for SSB interview tasks to build confidence.
